set.body:
Derive the discoverable record from the accepted descriptor and keep the private project label separate. Reuse the existing acceptance transaction and catalog interpreters.

Acceptance criteria

1. Specify source, cardinality, missing-value behavior and disclosure level for title, description, creators, keywords, data types and identifiers where supplied. Publish only fields permitted for the caller and release.
2. A rejected candidate has no public catalog record. Acceptance, retries and concurrent corrections yield one record per accepted release. R1 stays pinned after accepting R2.
3. A rebuild/backfill from retained releases gives the same records as live acceptance, handles older missing fields explicitly, and preserves existing release and manifest IDs.
4. The reference and PostgreSQL catalogs agree on both BIDS and archive fixtures including an archive with no scientific query index.

Verification

Persist independently expected records for old/new BIDS and archive deposits. Compare live, retried and rebuilt projections.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC02: Project a catalog record for each accepted BIDS or archive release
